description: Matched learned-edge extension of EXP002. The fit-only graph support, retained nodes, causal TCN, hidden widths, message-passing architecture, persistence residual and training protocol remain fixed. Existing command-to-target edges receive learned softmax weights initialized to the EXP002 equal-weight graph.

SMAP.description: All varying command-context nodes connect to the telemetry target with equal fixed weights.

MSL.description: Four command-context nodes selected using fit-only lagged association with telemetry target changes.

notes: TRAIN-only learned-edge tuning experiment. Graph support is identical to EXP002 and remains fixed. Only relative edge weights are learnable. NASA TEST arrays and anomaly labels are not used. CPU retained for the matched EXP002 comparison.
